text:
incident-bot: PAGER — runtime-gpu-canary showing significant service degradation after recent rollout. p95 latency +50% and p99 latency +70% vs baseline. Throughput on canary down ~40%. Kernel fallback counter increased from ~2/hr to ~120/hr. Dashboard: https://graf.redwood/g/canary-xyz

alex: paging eng-oncall — sounds like canary flip earlier tonight. tagging eng-runtime.

jen: confirmed spike correlates with flag rollout 'kernel_experiment_v3' at 2026-03-15T02:10Z. Initial logs show kv-cache miss storms and batch requeues. Reproducing on a local canary replica.

ryan: do we have an automated kill-switch for kernel_experiment_v3? If not, manual toggle and route traffic away. This is customer-impacting.

deploy-bot: Feature flags: 'kernel_experiment_v3' = true for env=canary. Toggle command: `/flag set kernel_experiment_v3 false --env canary`

alex: jen, flip and reduce canary traffic to 10%. Also mark incident P1.

jen: running toggle and traffic shift now:
```
# toggle off and shift traffic
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"kernel_experiment_v3","value":false,"env":"canary"}' https://flags.redwood.internal/flip
kubectl -n runtime patch svc runtime-canary -p '{"spec":{"traffic":0.1}}'
# result: flag updated, traffic reduced to 10%: OK
```

infra-bot: kernel_experiment_v3=false applied. Traffic rebalanced: 90% of previous canary load redirected to stable pool.

incident-bot: 3m follow-up: p95 down ~22%, kernel fallback events down ~85%, throughput still ~18% below normal. Continuing to observe.

maria: support update: multiple downstream partners reported elevated error rates and timeouts between 02:12-02:28 UTC. Noted two enterprise customers flagged by monitoring. We issued immediate acknowledgement.

ryan: given throughput not fully recovered and batch retries persisting, we should rollback the canary binary to previous build and run targeted e2e focusing on batching+kv interactions.

jen: initiating canary rollback to build sha: 0a1b2c3d:
```
# rollback canary deployment
kubectl -n runtime rollout undo deployment/runtime-canary --to-revision=0a1b2c3d
```

deploy-bot: Rollback command accepted. Estimated rollout time: ~6 minutes. Will post status.

incident-bot: 12m post-rollback: throughput returning to baseline, p95/p99 close to normal. No sustained increase in error rates after rollback. Kernel fallback counts normalized.

alex: hold canary releases for 45m. jen to draft test plan for kernel changes that includes KV-cache invariants and batch compatibility. Also add a step in the pipeline to run synthetic load mixing batching and long context to catch regressions.

jen: will add gating tests and add a pre-release canary shadow traffic run for new kernel variants. Also adding an alert in incident-bot rules to differentiate kernel fallback spikes vs generic errors.

maria: CS follow-ups scheduled and we'll include timeline + mitigation details. Offering SLA credit if thresholds hit.

ryan: thanks team. After 45m stability window, we'll close the page and start RCA. Good triage here. :thanks:

jen: logging timeline in the incident doc and opening PR for rollout safety checks.

alex: closing note: cause=kernel-experiment + batching config mismatch; mitigation=feature flag off + rollback; actions=open PRs for gating, update runbook, improve monitoring. Incident moved to post-incident review. :white_check_mark:
